data.reason_zh: 自动演化外部 harness：以交互与主动反馈驱动组件级修改，演化结果迁移到新任务和其他模型，属持续性 Harness 改进。

scope_support.feedback_quote: It then augments trajectory-derived evidence with proactive first-person feedback from the agent about harness usage, yielding richer signals for evolution.
scope_support.object_quote: HarnessCompass first enforces global constraints on evolution, restricting modifications to task-agnostic harness changes that generalize beyond the evolution tasks.
scope_support.persistence_quote: the evolved harness transfers effectively to held-out tasks and other models, demonstrating substantially stronger generalization than prior automatic harness evolution methods.
